d: A sudden outage of the email service provided by Microsoft—the world’s largest software company—that began late Thursday night has caused widespread disruption globally. The incident is affecting the operations of many major companies. With the servers for Outlook and Microsoft 365 going down, millions of users across the world, including in India, are facing significant inconvenience. Initially, Microsoft believed that this issue was limited to the United States, but it later emerged that it could have a global impact. The company is working to resolve the matter as quickly as possible.
